name: Exp_XDidi_Index_Cloud_Duplex
summary: This EA implements a duplex trading system based on the XDidi Index Cloud indicator, which is derived from the Didi Index (a Brazilian trend-following indicator). It opens buy and sell positions based on crossover signals of the indicator's three moving average components and uses a cloud visualization for trend confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XDidi Index Cloud指标实现双工交易系统，该指标源自巴西的Didi指标（一种趋势跟踪指标）。通过指标三条移动平均线组分的交叉信号开仓做多或做空，并利用云图可视化来确认趋势方向。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Didi指数，这是一种巴西市场流行的趋势跟踪指标，由三条不同周期的移动平均线构成，通过它们的交叉关系判断趋势方向。入场条件：当短期均线上穿中期和长期均线时开多仓，当短期均线下穿中期和长期均线时开空仓，Cloud区域的颜色变化也作为辅助确认信号。出场条件：依赖反向交叉信号平仓，或通过固定的止损止盈参数出场。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过MoneyManagement选项可切换为基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理方面提供了止损百分比控制，但整体风控机制较为基础，缺乏波动率自适应的仓位调整。该EA同时支持两个方向的交易（Duplex模式），可以在多空之间灵活切换。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Didi Index, a popular Brazilian trend-following indicator composed of three moving averages with different periods, using their crossover relationships to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the short-term MA crosses above the medium and long-term MAs, and a short position is opened when the short-term MA crosses below the medium and long-term MAs, with the Cloud color change serving as an auxiliary confirmation signal. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals for position closure, or through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach by default, with a MoneyManagement option to switch to a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides stop-loss percentage control, but overall risk management is relatively basic, lacking volatility-adaptive position sizing. The EA supports duplex (bi-directional) trading mode, allowing flexible switching between long and short positions based on the indicator signals.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 资金管理开关，启用后根据账户余额动态计算手数
parameters.description_en: Money management switch; dynamically calculates lots based on balance

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示禁用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 means no trailing

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Minimum step to adjust take-profit in points

parameters.name: VolumePosition
parameters.description: 是否考虑成交量确认信号
parameters.description_en: Whether to confirm signals with volume

parameters.name: ReversalSignal
parameters.description: 是否启用反转信号模式

pros: 基于Didi指数的趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，具有较强的趋势识别能力
支持双工交易模式，可同时处理多空两个方向的信号
提供资金管理选项，可根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic based on the Didi Index with strong trend identification capability
Supports duplex trading mode, handling both long and short direction signals simultaneously
Provides money management option for dynamic position sizing based on account balance
cons: 在震荡行情中均线交叉会产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁亏损
止损止盈采用固定点数而非波动率自适应，在不同市场条件下效果差异大
缺乏成交量和波动率过滤机制，容易在低流动性时段产生错误交易
cons_en: Moving average crossovers generate numerous false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent losses
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points rather than volatility-adaptive, resulting in inconsistent performance across different market conditions
Lacks volume and volatility filtering mechanisms, prone to erroneous trades during low liquidity periods
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率动态调整止损止盈距离
添加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX），在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit mechanism to dynamically adjust exit levels based on market volatility
Implement a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trading frequency or pause trading during ranging market conditions

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在不同波动率环境下可能导致止损过近或过远
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在大幅点差时仍可能入场
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit may result in stops being too tight or too loose under different volatility conditions
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter, may enter trades even when spread is excessively wide

It opens buy and sell positions based on crossover signals of the indicator's three moving average components and uses a cloud visualization for trend confirmation.
